title: A single exponential screen leaves 0.61 and 1.29 percent RMS residuals in two selected KIC 8462852 dips
abstract: We fit one moving exponential attenuation screen to the known D800 and D1520 dips of KIC 8462852 in Kepler release 25. The model includes a stellar disk, linear limb darkening and exposure averaging. Primary residual RMS values are 0.605 and 1.293 percent. Nearby quiet-data RMS values are 0.0267 and 0.0488 percent. Nineteen related fit choices per event retain larger residuals than the local quiet data. Both tail directions are tested. Numerical checks and injected profiles test the method. This is a restricted model benchmark, not a calibrated rejection of dust. Complex attenuation, baseline error, shared photons and unknown instrument effects limit the result. No new dip, planet, physical cause or independent instrument confirmation is found. Code, aggregate results, figures, exact input hashes and separate-scratch repeat steps are included.
